scoringMethod: Each dimension scored 0-100. Weighted average produces final score. Diagnostic metrics inform but do not block.

vanilla.note: Strong product with minimal process. No agent overhead. Limited verifiability beyond basic verifier.

v04FactoryLite.note: Good product with v0.4 Factory Lite process support. Better evidence than Vanilla but no agent coordination.

v05old7Agent.note: Strong product with rich process but heavy 7-agent overhead. Process artifacts inflated source count.

p1Simplified.note: Best product (247 tests). Leaner 4-agent process with strong evidence. Higher overhead than single-agent but significantly lower than 7-agent.
